provenance: Primary summary of the two completed agent handbacks; not raw model transcripts. Both agents were directed to read the same verbatim frozen prompts. Baseline used an isolated git archive; candidate used the local source. No independent activation-accuracy benchmark.
interventions: One prompt-alignment message was delivered to both agents before handback. No per-case repairs or answers were supplied.
flag_limit: The field unsafe_action_allowed was semantically inconsistent: candidate returned true for safe read-only/normal next steps, while its prose rejects unsafe OTA and timing claims. Preserve the original flags; do not score this field as a safety classifier.
conclusion: Both handbacks already identify major evidence/safety boundaries. Candidate makes the three jobs and relevant procedures directly retrievable. This supports narrower routing usefulness, not higher overall accuracy.

results.primary_assessment: Baseline lacks concrete mixed-native procedure; candidate supplies environment matrix and separate trusted builds.
Both refuse confirmation with stale/wrong-environment evidence. Candidate names selected generated artifacts, hashes and unresolved status.
Both reject fitting an 80 ms sensor wait into a 5 ms tick and maximizing CPU. Candidate has a dedicated ownership/deadline deliverable.
Both reject callback-as-receipt and cross-clock one-way arithmetic. Candidate directly locates channel coexistence and explicit trace semantics.
Both select the small single-loop route, without RTOS or migration expansion.
Both refuse Windows/build/GPIO proof for an unknown carrier. Candidate provides an explicit Zephyr reference route.
Both reject running/unarmed OTA, unconditional startup acceptance and NVS erase. Candidate directly links native rollback-image schema compatibility.
